parameters.content:
## CRM layer added here

This section runs after `Final Lead Record`.

It performs:

1. Normalize domain and company ID
2. Upsert `company:*`
3. Bulk upsert `contact:*`
4. Create one `discovery:*` event
5. Run outreach eligibility guard - accepts EMAIL, PHONE, or INSTAGRAM/social link as a valid contact channel (fixed: used to require email only, which silently held every phone/Instagram-only lead forever)
6. Produce a clean Google Sheets row for READY leads, and a second Manual Review sheet row for HOLD leads (see Manual Review Notes)
7. Discord batch summary, including how many prospects were logged this run

Obsidian is not written directly. Use `<CRM_DB_NAME>` as source of truth and Obsidian as a human presentation layer later.

parameters.jsCode:
const incoming = $('Normalize CRM Lead').item.json;
const now = new Date().toISOString();

return [{
  json: {
    _id: incoming.company_id,
    type: 'company',

    canonical_domain: incoming.canonical_domain,
    company_name: incoming.company_name || incoming.canonical_domain,
    website: incoming.website || `https://${incoming.canonical_domain}`,
    country: incoming.business_country || '',

    persona: incoming.persona || '',
    priority: incoming.priority || '',
    lifecycle_status: incoming.priority === 'REJECT' ? 'rejected' : 'new',

    first_seen_at: now,
    last_seen_at: now,
    times_discovered: 1,
    last_run_id: incoming.crm_run_id,

    best_icp_score: Number(incoming.icp_score || 0),
    best_intent_score: Number(incoming.intent_score || 0),
    best_priority: incoming.priority || '',

    do_not_contact: false,
    active_contact_id: null,
    last_contacted_at: null,
    next_contact_allowed_at: null,

    latest_profile: {
      services: incoming.services || [],
      destinations_sold: incoming.destinations_sold || [],
      intent_signals: incoming.intent_signals || [],
      evidence: incoming.evidence || [],
      reason: incoming.reason || '',
      personalized_first_line: incoming.personalized_first_line || ''
    },

    source: {
      discovery_source: incoming.discovery_source || '',
      discovery_query: incoming.discovery_query || ''
    }
  }
}];

const j = $json;

return [{
  json: {
    company_name: j.company_name || '',
    website: j.website || '',
    domain: j.canonical_domain || j.domain || '',
    country: j.business_country || '',
    persona: j.persona || '',
    priority: j.priority || '',
    icp_score: j.icp_score ?? '',
    intent_score: j.intent_score ?? '',

    contact_channel: j.contact_channel || 'none',
    contact_value: j.contact_value || '',
    phone: j.phone || '',
    instagram_url:
      (j.instagram_links || [])[0] ||
      j.social_links?.instagram?.[0] ||
      j.contact_hints?.instagram_links?.[0] ||
      '',

    personalized_first_line: j.personalized_first_line || '',
    reason: j.reason || '',

    outreach_eligibility: j.outreach_eligibility || '',
    hold_reason: j.hold_reason || '',

    crm_company_id: j.company_id || '',
    run_id: j.crm_run_id || ''
  }
}];

## Budget + batch mode (corrected)

Real caps now enforced (single source: Search Strategy Config -> strategy_config.budget):

- 10 Outscraper queries/run
- 20 Maps results/query
- 120 raw unique domains before CRM skip
- 35 companies through the free regex Homepage Evidence Gate
- 15 new companies actually crawled + DeepSeek'd/run (this used to silently run as 118-250; that bug is fixed)
- max 2 deep pages/company
- one Discord batch summary per run, now also reporting prospect-log count

Known companies saved to CouchDB (`company:*`) are skipped before Crawl4AI/DeepSeek. Every company Maps returns (~120/run) is now separately logged as a lightweight `prospect:*` doc regardless of whether it gets crawled this run - see Prospect Log Notes.

parameters.content:
## Prospect log (new)

Every company Outscraper returns this run (after dedupe/country filter) gets a lightweight `prospect:*` doc in CouchDB here — win or lose, crawled or not.

This is separate from `company:*` docs (full CRM records created only after DeepSeek research). It exists so a company that got cut by the crawl-budget cap, or rejected at any gate, is still queryable later instead of vanishing.

Fire-and-forget: never blocks or slows the main discovery -> crawl chain.
